text:
Ryan (ML): Heads up — I merged the new next-starter-langchain demo (PR #542) but I'm seeing onboarding friction. Local dev: streaming responses randomly drop and sometimes show a 401. Anyone hit this?

Sam E.: Yep. Repro'd. When I use the JS SDK streaming client I get a console error: "Unauthorized: missing API key" but the REST call with the same token works.

Sam E.: Console snippet:```js
// using next-starter sample
const stream = Redwood.stream({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini' , apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
stream.on('data', chunk => console.log(chunk))
```

Maya (Docs): The quickstart currently tells people to set REDWOOD_API_KEY in .env.local. Our node SDK checks for REDWOOD_TOKEN in process.env (legacy name). That mismatch will cause the 401s if the sample uses the new var name but the SDK reads the old one.

Alice (DevEx): Oof. That explains a lot. Also noticed the streaming client doesn't do exponential backoff on 502/503 — it retries immediately and then just dies. For local dev flakiness that's a bad DX. I can PR a small wrapper util for samples that adds jitter + backoff.

Greg (Support): We have a support ticket from a customer trying the starter with the LlamaIndex connector. They hit a rate-limit because embeddings were being flushed with batch size 1 in the sample. Easier to reproduce with small datasets.

Ryan (ML): I ran the eval harness against the starter and some tests fail nondeterministically — looks like tokenization drift between llama-tokenizer v1 vs v2. The harness expects deterministic token counts for our eval prompts.

deploy-bot: Deploy failed for branch next-starter-pr-542 — e2e/onboard tests failed (see CI link: https://ci.internal/runs/2345).

Alice (DevEx): Proposed action items:
1) Patch sample to accept either REDWOOD_API_KEY or REDWOOD_TOKEN (env fallback) and update .env.example.
2) Add a small retry-with-backoff wrapper in the samples/util and reference it in the Quickstart.
3) Add a lightweight eval case in the harness to catch tokenizer mismatches (fail fast in CI).
4) Update LlamaIndex connector example to use batchSize >= 8 by default and call out rate-limit behavior in comments/README.
I'll open the PRs and issues now and tag owners.

Sam E.: sgtm. I'll take the retry wrapper and SDK change to read both env names (will add tests).

Ryan (ML): I'll take tokenizer/version pinning in the eval harness and add a deterministic token-count test.

Maya (Docs): I'll update the quickstart and the starter README with a Troubleshooting section that shows the exact 401 log and the env var mapping.

Greg (Support): I'll reply to the customer with a workaround (set BATCH_SIZE=8) and link the starter PR once it's up.

Alice (DevEx): Opening: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/issues/87 (env + retry + eval followups). Assigning tags: devex, sdk, samples, docs.

Ryan (ML): Thanks — ping me when PRs are up :rocket:

Sam E.: thx — will push a draft in a few hours.
